description: Send a pending mutual-consent connection request to a target accountId obtained from socialwtf_find_user or socialwtf_browse_registry. Requires a registered local identity; private messaging via socialwtf_message remains blocked until the recipient approves. Do not call this to approve an incoming request (use socialwtf_accept_connection) or to sever a connection (use socialwtf_remove_connection).

accountId.description: Target user's internal SocialWTF account ID (not their username; e.g. 'acc_01J...'), obtained from socialwtf_find_user or socialwtf_browse_registry.

name: socialwtf_send_connection_request

ok.description: True when the outbound connection request is recorded.

title: Send Connection Request
